evals.prompt: Migrate our Vite + React app from react-i18next to Nordbeam Locale. Catalogs are in src/locales/en.json and src/locales/fr.json, source is in src. The app mostly uses t('namespace.key', { name }) with a few <Trans> components and one t(`status.${state}`).
evals.expected_output: A reviewed preview, an applied migration, finished bindings, resolved skipped constructs and a passing verify.
expectations: Installs nordbeam-locale and @nordbeam/locale-migrate (and @nordbeam/locale for the framework adapter) at the same version before running migrate-project
Runs migrate-project with --format react-i18next --framework vite-react --source-dir src and --json WITHOUT --write first, and summarises counts and skipped codes for the user
Passes --initial-locale-expression (or asks which expression holds the initial locale) instead of guessing it
Notices the dynamic key (DYNAMIC_MESSAGE_KEY) and the <Trans> components (RICH_MESSAGE) in the preview and handles them deliberately (explicit map of literal keys, ICU rich tags with rich())
Only applies with --write after the preview, then runs generate, check and finds files where the rewritten m is not bound and binds it with i18n.useI18n()
Replaces the i18next provider and init code with the Nordbeam provider and changeLanguage with setLocale
Does not delete legacy catalogs or the i18next dependency before verify passes and the user agrees
Ends with verify --json exit status 0 and a summary of what was migrated automatically versus by hand

evals.prompt: We want to move our Next.js App Router app from next-intl to Nordbeam Locale. messages/en.json and messages/de.json, routes in src/app/[locale], src/middleware.ts uses next-intl/middleware, next.config.mjs uses createNextIntlPlugin.
evals.expected_output: migrate-project previewed and applied for next, then the middleware, routing, config and server components finished by hand, with exactly one request file.
expectations: Previews with migrate-project --format next-intl --framework next before applying
After --write, binds m in server components with i18n.hasLocale and await i18n.loadLocale(locale) where the report says the shape was not conventional
Ends with exactly one request file beside src/app (moves or removes the scaffolded root proxy.ts and the old next-intl middleware.ts)
Rewrites the routing module with defineRouting from @nordbeam/locale/next/routing and replaces createNextIntlPlugin with withNordbeamLocale
Converts t.rich usage to rich() with ICU tags
Runs generate, check, a production build or type-check, and verify --json

evals.prompt: Convert our vue-i18n catalogs (src/locales/en.json, fr.json) to Nordbeam Locale. Some messages look like 'no apples | one apple | {count} apples' and 'Hi {0} and {1}'.
evals.expected_output: The agent catches that vue-i18n pipe plurals and positional placeholders are copied verbatim and converts them to ICU by hand.
expectations: Previews migrate-project with --format vue-i18n --framework vue
Searches the migrated catalogs for pipe plurals, @: links and {0}-style placeholders because the tool does not convert them
Converts the pipe plural to an ICU plural with =0, one and other branches in every locale
Renames {0} {1} to named arguments and updates call sites
Binds m through i18n.useI18n() with messages as a ref (m.value in script, m in template) and replaces the vue-i18n plugin with the Nordbeam Vue adapter
Runs check --strict and verify --json

evals.prompt: Our translators gave us a French PO file (locales/fr.po) from our old gettext setup and an English one. Get them into Nordbeam Locale.
evals.expected_output: Catalogs converted with migrate --format po, warnings about sentence IDs and printf placeholders handled.
expectations: Runs migrate (or migrate-project with --catalog-format po) with --dry-run --json and reads the converted output and warnings first
Does not use the import command for a foreign PO file
Handles DOTTED_SOURCE_ID / sentence IDs (renames to semantic IDs or uses an ID map) and renames printf-converted arguments
Writes to a new --out path, never overwriting an existing catalog
Runs generate, check --strict and verify --json

evals.prompt: Our Angular app uses Transloco. Can you migrate it to Nordbeam Locale?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that Angular has codemods only (no runtime adapter) and confirms scope before changing anything.
expectations: States that Nordbeam Locale has no Angular runtime adapter before making changes
If proceeding, uses --format transloco with --catalog-format i18next because of {{name}} interpolation and omits --framework
Does not remove the Transloco runtime or providers automatically
Lists the manual work (DI wiring, templates, bootstrap) from the report

evals.prompt: Run the Nordbeam codemod on our react-intl code and apply it, I'm in a hurry.
evals.expected_output: The agent still previews, reviews skipped constructs and uses a plan or preview before writing.
expectations: Runs a preview (no --write) or writes a reviewed plan with --plan before applying
Reports skipped constructs and manual actions to the user before applying
Applies with apply-plan --from or --write only after the review, and checks for unbound m afterwards
Ends with generate, check and verify --json
